---
title: "F-test paper DGP API"
subtitle: "Configurations, profile catalogs, reusable factories, and one-draw functions"
---

```{python}
import inspect

import pypanelsim as pps


def show_signature(object_):
    print(f"{object_.__name__}{inspect.signature(object_)}")
```

## Catalogs

```{python}
print(pps.available_ftest_temporal_designs())
print(pps.available_ftest_cohort_designs())
```

The first tuple contains the seven single-cohort temporal laws. The second
contains all seven across-cohort experiments in the manuscript, including
`novelty_effects`.

## `FTestTemporalConfig`

```{python}
show_signature(pps.FTestTemporalConfig)
```

Controls unit and period counts, the single adoption period and treated count,
effect scale, additive fixed-effect scales, unit-trend scale, and stationary
AR(1) error parameters. `n_treated=None` means half the units. The default
$N=1{,}000$ is interactive; the paper uses $N=50{,}000$.

Derived properties are `treated_count` and `dimensions`.

## `FTestCohortConfig`

```{python}
show_signature(pps.FTestCohortConfig)
```

Controls the three adoption periods and cohort shares, panel dimensions,
additive fixed-effect and noise scales, unit and time AR coefficients, and the
periodic calendar-effect vector. `cohort_sizes` floors each share times
`n_units`; `dimensions` returns the generic panel shape. Defaults reproduce the
paper's $(10,15,20)$ schedule and $(1/8,1/4,1/8)$ shares with a smaller
interactive unit count. The paper uses $N=20{,}000$.

## Effect profiles

```{python}
show_signature(pps.ftest_temporal_profile)
show_signature(pps.ftest_cohort_profiles)
```

`ftest_temporal_profile()` returns one read-only post-adoption vector. Supply
`seed=` or `rng=` for a reproducible `random_walk`; deterministic paths do not
consume it. `ftest_cohort_profiles()` returns a read-only mapping from adoption
period to a read-only post-adoption vector.

The paths are ordinary inputs to the generic effect component:

```{python}
config = pps.FTestCohortConfig(n_units=200)
profiles = pps.ftest_cohort_profiles("activity_bias", config=config)
effect = pps.CohortEventTimeEffect(profiles)
```

## Reusable simulator factories

```{python}
show_signature(pps.ftest_temporal_design)
show_signature(pps.ftest_cohort_design)
```

Both return `PanelSimulator`. `ftest_temporal_design()` accepts a separate
`profile_seed` so the random-walk truth can remain fixed while repeated panel
draws vary. The cohort factory uses exact fixed-size randomized cohorts.

```{python}
simulator = pps.ftest_cohort_design(
    "log_vs_linear_vs_sin",
    config=config,
)
panel = simulator.simulate(seed=42)
```

## One-draw functions

```{python}
show_signature(pps.ftest_temporal)
show_signature(pps.ftest_cohort)
```

These create the corresponding simulator and immediately call `simulate()`.
They accept the same configuration plus the standard mutually exclusive
`seed=` and `rng=` arguments.

See the [complete F-test DGP vignette](../vignettes/ftest-heterogeneity.qmd)
for every formula, all fourteen true-effect plots, and representative $Y$/$W$
matrices.
